Popular Nollywood actress Mercy Aigbe has announced that she is expecting a baby.
The actress shared the news on her Instagram page on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, posting photographs showing her baby bump with the caption, “Some journeys begin with a little heartbeat… and change the course of a lifetime.”
Her announcement quickly drew congratulatory messages from fans and fellow entertainers across the film industry.
Her husband, film producer and marketer Kazim Adeoti, popularly known as Adekaz, also celebrated the news on his Instagram page.
“Motherhood, one of life’s most beautiful gifts,” Adeoti wrote. “A journey of unconditional love, endless sacrifice, and a kind of strength words can never fully describe.”
The pregnancy announcement comes nearly five years after Aigbe and Adeoti tied the knot in December 2021. Their marriage became public in January 2022, attracting widespread attention across Nigerian entertainment circles.
Aigbe, widely known for her work in Yoruba-language films, already has two children from previous relationships. She and her husband have also collaborated on several major film projects, including Ada Omo Daddy, alongside multiple YouTube productions.
